function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the live web for current, factual, or time-sensitive information you do not already know — news, prices, releases, docs, events, anything likely to have changed after your training cutoff. Call this on your own whenever a good answer depends on up-to-date facts; the user does not need to ask you to search.

query.description: A focused search query (what you'd type into a search box).

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate a NEW image from a text prompt (FLUX-dev). Write a RICH, specific prompt — subject + composition + lighting + style + camera/lens + mood (like a good photographer/art-director brief), not just a few words; prompt quality drives image quality. Pick width/height to fit the scene (e.g. 1344x768 landscape, 768x1344 portrait, 1024x1024 square). The image is auto-attached to your reply.

prompt.description: Rich, detailed prompt (composition, lighting, style, mood).

function.name: edit_image
function.description: Restyle the WHOLE image via natural language (img2img) — this re-renders the ENTIRE frame, so it changes everything, not just one thing. Use ONLY for global changes: overall style, mood, lighting, season, art medium ('make it look like a watercolor', 'make it nighttime'). To change ONE object/area while keeping the rest intact, use inpaint_region instead.

function.name: upscale_image
function.description: 4× upscale an existing image. Use an image_path from <recent_images>.

function.name: inpaint_region
function.description:
PREFERRED for targeted edits: change/replace ONE thing while keeping the rest of the image identical (FLUX-fill, no mask). Use for 'change the food to fish', 'replace the sign text', 'put a hat on him', 'make the car red' — any localized change. You can SEE the image and <recent_images> gives its pixel size — give the bbox of JUST the thing to change. Runs on the fast 5090 (handles large/upscaled images). Do NOT use edit_image for localized changes — it would alter the whole picture.
PROMPT TIP: describe the FULL desired content of that region IN the scene's style + lighting (e.g. 'a tall arcing white water-fountain spray with fine mist, dusk lighting, photoreal' — NOT just 'fountain'), or FLUX fills it with something generic/wrong. Box tightly around just the thing to change.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels (top-left origin) of the region to regenerate

prompt.description: what should appear in that region

function.name: outpaint
function.description: Extend/expand an image's canvas in a direction (FLUX-fill, no mask). Use for 'zoom out', 'show more above', 'make it wider'. Runs on the 5090.

prompt.description: what to fill the new area with

function.name: animate_image
function.description: Turn a still image into a short looping VIDEO (SVD img2vid). Adds camera motion, parallax, and ambient movement (water, light, cloud) — a living cinemagraph. It does NOT move/animate subjects (won't make a person walk or a car drive). Use for 'make it move', 'animate this', 'bring it to life'. Takes ~90s. Use an image_path from <recent_images>.
